definitions.explanation: A train car, or a rental car, in which smoking is permitted, as opposed to a non-smoking one.

examples.japanese: {喫煙車|きつえんしゃ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{乗|の}る→乗る：00511_noru⟧。
examples.english: to ride in a smoking car.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{列車|れっしゃ}→列車：01670_ressha⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{喫煙車|きつえんしゃ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧。
examples.english: This train has no smoking car.

examples.japanese: ⟦{最近|さいきん}→最近：00881_saikin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{喫煙車|きつえんしゃ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{廃止|はいし}→廃止：12483_haishi⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{鉄道|てつどう}→鉄道：03550_tetsudou⟧{会社|がいしゃ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}えている→増える：01183_fueru⟧。
examples.english: Recently, more railway companies are abolishing smoking cars.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{喫煙|きつえん}→喫煙：17580_kitsuen⟧ ('smoking') + ⟦{車|しゃ}→車：09874_sha⟧ ('car, vehicle'). Refers to a train car (or a rental car) where smoking is allowed.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {喫煙車|きつえんしゃ}{両|りょう}: smoking car of a train

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{禁煙車|きんえんしゃ}→禁煙車：24578_kinensha⟧: non-smoking car — the direct antonym
- ⟦{喫煙者|きつえんしゃ}→喫煙者：27918_kitsuensha⟧: smoker (a person) — a homophone with a different meaning
